g.text: Scores are the Everpure Tech Atlas's qualitative assessment from public sources (Chapters 27, 34, 37, 42-44). Grey outlines show the other three vendors. Axes are unweighted; do not sum them. One-line rationale per score in data/ch45_radar.csv (source column).
